title: Add a complete database interview preparation guide
body:
## Summary

The current roadmap includes database topics, but the section would be much stronger with a dedicated interview-focused guide that explains the concepts clearly and connects them to practical backend and system design use cases.

## Proposed addition

Add a structured database guide covering:

- what a database and DBMS are
- SQL vs NoSQL
- schema design
- primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, and checks
- normalization and denormalization
- joins
- transactions
- ACID properties
- isolation levels and common anomalies
- indexing and tradeoffs
- query tuning
- views, materialized views, stored procedures, and triggers
- replication
- partitioning and sharding
- CAP / BASE / eventual consistency
- PostgreSQL vs DynamoDB
- idempotency, retries, and unique constraints
- database security basics
- backup and recovery
- common database interview questions
- a recommended study path
- strong book/resource recommendations

## Why this would help

This would make the repository much more useful for backend, full-stack, and system design interview preparation, not just DSA-focused interview prep.

## Suggested resource additions

- **Database System Concepts** by Abraham Silberschatz, Henry F. Korth, and S. Sudarshan
- **Readings in Database Systems** by Joseph M. Hellerstein and Michael Stonebraker
